sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.atom_id) AS percent
FROM 
    atom a
JOIN 
    connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE 
    b.bond_type = '-'
